name: components-backgrounds-hole
title: Hole Background
blurb: Discs and particles stream through an elliptical hole, animated continuously.
description: Canvas-based background with concentric discs tweening downward through a central hole and particles falling through. Runs a continuous RAF loop with radial gradient overlays.
use_when: A dramatic, animated page background that should command visual attention without user interaction.
avoid_when: Performance-sensitive pages or mobile devices — the RAF loop runs constantly and never idles, consuming significant…
a11y: Passive background wrapper; focus and keyboard behaviour come from children. Continuous animation may cause motion sickness; no prefers-reduced-motion guard.
